purpose: lower-complexity extension: 12 instances at a fixed oracle optimum. Level labels describe conflict density and never task size; n is a generator parameter and is not a complexity metric

boundary_derivation.rule: the frozen n = 8 cut-points as densities, floored at this size: easy is D <= 1/28, medium is D <= 7/28

selection.rule: earliest admissible selection in canonical order (seed, travel structure, tightness, overlap) at O = 3

diversity.travel_structure_rule: exact and identical at every size, so a change in n is not accompanied by a change in travel topology; supersedes the weaker 'at least 2 structures' rule, which an equal split satisfies
